description: POST /v0/sql takes caller-named template parameters beside `q` in its JSON body (https://www.tinybird.co/docs/api-reference/query-api: `{"q":"% SELECT * FROM <pipe> where column_name = {{String(column_name)}}", "column_name": "column_name_value"}`). The request is an open object so those keys typecheck; they travel as JSON body keys. Live: querySqlWithBody({ q: "% SELECT {{Int32(n, 0)}} * 2 AS doubled FORMAT JSON", n: 21 }) answered data [{doubled: 42}].
